fixes.name: UE3D Monitor Mode (Evil___Kermit fork)

platform.note: Requires SteamVR, VRto3D (EK fork), and 3DGameBridge (EK fork). All three must be from Evil___Kermit's repo.

display_restriction.note: UE3D Monitor Mode is designed specifically for SR/Leia displays with head tracking. Not useful on standard monitors.

fixes.pros: Full Kooima-style window projection for SR displays — motion parallax, Z stereo depth, Z FOV modulation. Pre-configured game profile with Engine.ini stereo fixes included.
fixes.cons: Pre-release. Requires three separate fork replacements (UEVR, VRto3D, 3DGameBridge). Must use exact matching versions. Incompatible with standard builds.
issues: Enabling LookAround at the main menu may cause cropping — enable after loading into the game
Still requires SteamVR even though no headset is needed for monitor output
All three EK forks must be the exact matching versions (UE3D protocol v4.0)
fixes.notes: Requires UEVR v2.2 + VRto3D v2.0 + 3DGameBridge v2.0, all from evilkermitreturns on GitHub. A tested game profile (TheOuterWorlds2-Win64-Shipping.zip) and Engine.ini with shadow/lumen/lighting stereo fixes are included in the UEVR v2.2 release assets. Back up your existing UEVR/VRto3D/3DGameBridge installs before replacing. The plan is for these changes to eventually merge into mainline UEVR, VRto3D, and 3DGameBridge.
fixes.activation:
1. Back up existing UEVR, VRto3D, and 3DGameBridge installs.
2. Download UEVR v2.2 from evilkermitreturns/UEVR and replace UEVRBackend.dll + openvr_api.dll.
3. Download VRto3D v2.0 from evilkermitreturns/VRto3D and extract drivers to Steam/config/.
4. Download 3DGameBridge v2.0 from evilkermitreturns/3DGameBridgeProjects and place srReshade.addon64 in the game folder.
5. Extract the UEVR profile (TheOuterWorlds2-Win64-Shipping.zip) to %AppData%\UnrealVRMod\Profiles\.
6. Copy Engine.ini to %LocalAppData%\Arkansas\Saved\Config\Windows\.
7. Launch the game, then inject UEVR. In the Monitor 3D tab, enable LookAround after loading into gameplay.
